name: design-options
goal: A Plan of a visual unit saves N distinct, separately generated design options (default 3, 1..10) in one immutable version; approval and threads bind one exact option; old single designs still read.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Default three visual designs; count one to ten; exact option approval and threads; headless plans keep cases.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Opus implemented generation, immutable option storage, count controls and option switching. Product hashes frozen and independently reviewed.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Focused unit/integration checks passed; latest same-guard old UI red and fourteen green browser checks. Fourteen fresh screenshots inspected; compiled/full budgets pending.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
